video_summary.overall_goal: Navigate to AdAway list management and attempt to add a host entry to the allowed/whitelist list.
video_summary.description: The screen recording shows the AdAway dashboard, navigation into the Your lists screen, use of search, opening the add-host dialog, entering unclear short text, attempting to add it, and returning between the dashboard and list screen.

steps.what_screen_is_visible: The AdAway main dashboard is visible with a red header, the AdAway logo, statistics cards, source status, shortcut cards, bottom navigation, and a red circular pause/action button near the bottom.
steps.target_element: Allowed/list area on the dashboard, partially obscured by finger
steps.system_response: The app navigates away from the dashboard.
steps.navigation_change: Dashboard changes to the Your lists screen.
steps.visual_feedback: The red dashboard header disappears and a dark list-management screen appears.
steps.intent_task: Open the list management area for host rules.

steps.what_screen_is_visible: The Your lists screen is visible in dark mode. The main content area appears empty. A back arrow, title, search icon, and another top-right icon are visible. A red floating plus button appears near the lower right, and bottom tabs show Blocked, Allowed, and Redirected.
steps.system_response: The title area changes into a search field.
steps.navigation_change: No page change; search mode opens on the same screen.
steps.visual_feedback: A search field with placeholder text appears at the top.

steps.what_screen_is_visible: The Your lists screen remains open with the search field active. The Android keyboard is visible at the bottom.
steps.system_response: The typed text appears in the search field and the list remains empty.
steps.visual_feedback: The search field shows short text that appears to read "uhkh"; no matching list items are visible.
steps.intent_task: Filter the host list by a typed query.

steps.what_screen_is_visible: The search screen is still active with the entered query visible and the floating plus button at the lower right.
steps.system_response: A modal dialog opens over the list screen.
steps.navigation_change: No page change; an add-host dialog overlays the current screen.
steps.visual_feedback: A dialog titled "Add host to whitelist" appears with a Hostname input field and CANCEL and ADD buttons.
steps.intent_task: Add a new host entry to the whitelist/allowed list.

steps.what_screen_is_visible: A modal dialog titled Add host to whitelist is visible over the Your lists search screen. The Hostname field is focused and the Android keyboard is open.
visible_ui_elements: helper or validation text mentioning wildcard characters
dimmed Your lists screen behind dialog
steps.system_response: The hostname field content changes several times and validation styling is shown.
steps.visual_feedback: Short text appears in the Hostname field; the field shows red validation styling. Some frames appear to show values like "bd", "0", or "pd", but the exact typed text is unclear.
steps.intent_task: Enter a hostname to add to the whitelist.

steps.what_screen_is_visible: The add-host dialog is visible with the Hostname field filled by unclear short text and the ADD button at the lower right of the dialog.
steps.system_response: The dialog closes and a toast/snackbar message appears near the bottom of the screen.
steps.navigation_change: Dialog closes; the app returns to the underlying Your lists search screen.
steps.visual_feedback: A brief message appears above the keyboard. The text is blurry, but it appears to be feedback about the entered hostname.

steps.what_screen_is_visible: The Your lists screen is visible with the search field still active and the keyboard open.
steps.target_element: top-left back arrow or system back action
steps.system_response: Search mode is closed and the title returns to Your lists.
steps.navigation_change: Search mode exits on the same Your lists screen.
steps.visual_feedback: The search field is replaced by the Your lists title while the list area remains mostly empty.

steps.what_screen_is_visible: The Your lists screen is visible with the normal title bar and bottom tabs.
steps.target_element: top-left back arrow or system back action
steps.system_response: The app returns to the main dashboard.
steps.navigation_change: Your lists changes back to the AdAway dashboard.
steps.visual_feedback: The red dashboard header and statistics cards reappear.
steps.intent_task: Return to the main AdAway screen.

steps.what_screen_is_visible: The AdAway dashboard is visible again with red header, statistics cards, source status, and shortcuts.
steps.target_element: Allowed/list area on the dashboard, partially obscured by finger
steps.system_response: The app navigates back to the Your lists screen.
steps.visual_feedback: The Your lists screen appears and a single visible list entry with short text, likely "pd", is shown.
steps.intent_task: Reopen the list management screen to inspect the host list.

overall_flow: Open Add host to whitelist dialog
Exit search/list screen back to dashboard
